sloka: यो न शक्यः सुरैर्हन्तुं न यक्षैर्नासुरैस्तथा ।सो ऽयं कश्चिदिवासत्त्वो मृत्युं मर्त्येन लम्भितः ।। ६.११३.१६ ।।
transliteration: yo na śakyaḥ surairhantuṁ na yakṣairnāsuraistathā ।so 'yaṁ kaścidivāsattvo mṛtyuṁ martyena lambhitaḥ ।। 6.113.16 ।।

translations.english: "He, who could not be killed by Suras, Asuras or Yakshas, such a hero lies like a weak person devoid of strength, killed by a mortal, is resting."
